description: Eight-step voltage sequencer, one knob per step, advanced by a clock

params.text: Sets the voltage that step puts out, 0V to 10V

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves the sequence on one step, wrapping round after the eighth
A rising edge returns the sequence to the first step

outputs.text: An 8V gate, high for as long as the sequence is on its first step
The voltage of the step the sequence is on

notes: The clock and reset are compared against 0V rather than a gate threshold, so any positive voltage reads as high.

inputs.0: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
